Notes:
Day 1 observations: At 03:00, both residents were home. Hana’s items (handbag, jacket, keys, wallet, shoes, phone, water bottle) appeared in entry/kitchen/bedroom, suggesting she returned from a late shift or was preparing for one, though her work shift starts at 13:40. Dana’s items (laptop, glasses, mug, water bottle) moved to the office between 03:00 and 11:20, consistent with her work routine. By 20:25, Dana’s water bottle and glass moved to the kitchen table, and her book moved to the couch, indicating evening relaxation. Hana’s items remained in entry/bedroom/kitchen, consistent with her being home in the morning and out for work in the afternoon/evening. No items were taken out of the house.
